ModMetaData.name: Beef Eaters Renew - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Beef Eaters Renew, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Everything here uses built-in Pickle steps, except the texture-ownership scenarios, which stage Nelim's Pickle Tools' TextureOwner for that one pass only (see wsl-deps.textures.map). Nothing here clicks through OS input.
